# The name of the mod loader type to load - for regular FML @Mod mods it should be javafml
modLoader="javafml" #mandatory

# A version range to match for said mod loader - for regular FML @Mod it will be the minecraft version (without the 1.)
loaderVersion="[34,)" #mandatory

# A URL to refer people to when problems occur with this mod
issueTrackerURL="https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/issues?q=is%3Aissue" #optional

# License
license="The MIT License (MIT)"

# A file name (in the root of the mod JAR) containing a logo for display
#logoFile="examplemod.png" #optional

# A text field displayed in the mod UI
#credits="Thanks for this example mod goes to Java" #optional

# A list of mods - how many allowed here is determined by the individual mod loader
[[mods]] #mandatory

# The modid of the mod
modId="jei" #mandatory

# The version number of the mod
version="7.8.1.1019" #mandatory

# A display name for the mod
displayName="Just Enough Items" #mandatory

# A URL for the "homepage" for this mod, displayed in the mod UI
displayURL="https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/jei" #optional

# A URL to query for updates for this mod. See the JSON update specification <here>
#updateJSONURL="" #optional

# A text field displayed in the mod UI
# credits="" #optional

# A text field displayed in the mod UI
authors="mezz" #optional

# The description text for the mod (multi line!) (#mandatory)
description='''
JEI is an item and recipe viewing mod for Minecraft, built from the ground up for stability and performance.
'''

modId="forge" #mandatory
mandatory=true #mandatory
versionRange="[34.0.3,)" #mandatory
# An ordering relationship for the dependency - BEFORE or AFTER required if the relationship is not mandatory

# Side this dependency is applied on - BOTH, CLIENT or SERVER
side="BOTH"

# Side this dependency is applied on - BOTH, CLIENT or SERVER

[[mods]]

updateJSONURL = "https://api.modrinth.com/updates/create/forge_updates.json?neoforge=only"

authors = "simibubi"
description = '''Technology that empowers the player.'''

[[mixins]]

[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "neoforge"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[21.1.219,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "minecraft"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[1.21.1]"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "flywheel"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[1.0.0,2.0)"
ordering = "AFTER"
side = "CLIENT"

[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "ponder"
type = "required"
versionRange = "[1.0.82,)"
ordering = "AFTER"
side = "BOTH"

# Versions before 0.6.9 do not have sprite util under the api package
[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "sodium"
type = "optional"
reason = "Versions before 0.6.9 do not include the neccesary APIs Create needs to work properly with Sodium."
versionRange = "[0.6.9,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "CLIENT"

# Versions before 0.14.7 crash with level wrappers
[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "lithium"
type = "optional"
reason = "Versions before 0.14.7 crash when paired with Create, Update Lithium."
versionRange = "[0.14.7,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

# Versions before 1.21.1-6.0.0-beta.46 do not contain the fullscreen render event we use
[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "journeymap"
type = "optional"
reason = "Versions before 1.21.1-6.0.0-beta.46 do not contain the APIs Create requires to work with JourneyMap."
versionRange = "[1.21.1-6.0.0-beta.46,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "CLIENT"

[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "xaeroworldmap"
type = "optional"
reason = "Versions before 1.40.2 do not contain the classes Create requires to work with Xaero's World Map."
versionRange = "[1.40.2,)"
ordering = "NONE"
side = "CLIENT"

# Incompatible Mods

# Users should use lithium instead, it's up to date and does not crash with level wrappers (anymore)
[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "radium"
type = "incompatible"
reason = "Radium is a unofficial port of Lithium, Lithium is now natively available for NeoForge and does not suffer from the same issues radium does, use Lithium instead."
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"

# Does not improve memory usage, results in connected textures not working as intended.
[[dependencies."create"]]
modId = "palladium"
type = "incompatible"
reason = "Palladium does not improve memory usage by anything meaningful, and results in broken visuals for Create's blocks with connected textures."
ordering = "NONE"
side = "BOTH"
